mcp-abap-adt/search.semantic: Activate one object or several objects together after a change.

description: Activates the object named by object_name and object_type (or object_adt_type), or the objects named by objects, in one request. Single form (object_name*, object_type or object_adt_type*): object_type is enough for CLASS, PROGRAM [onprem only], INTERFACE, FUNCTION_GROUP, TABLE, STRUCTURE, DDL, DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION, METADATA_EXTENSION, PACKAGE, SERVICE_DEFINITION and SERVICE_BINDING; any other type takes object_adt_type (e.g. "CLAS/OC"). List form (objects[].name*, objects[].type*, objects[].parentName, objects[].uri); a function module is listed with objects[].parentName set to its function group, type FUGR/FF. One object of CLASS, PROGRAM, INTERFACE, FUNCTION_GROUP, TABLE, STRUCTURE, DDL, DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION or METADATA_EXTENSION (by object_type or its ADT type code) is activated directly and answers the activation verdict. Every other call starts an activation run and answers { run_id }: the id of the accepted run, whose status and messages are read by that id. When objects is absent and object_adt_type is absent and object_type is one of DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, TABLE, STRUCTURE, DDL, CLASS, PROGRAM, INTERFACE, FUNCTION_GROUP, BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION, METADATA_EXTENSION; or objects is given; or objects is absent and object_adt_type is given; or objects is absent and object_adt_type is absent and object_type is one of PACKAGE, SERVICE_DEFINITION, SERVICE_BINDING, recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

object_adt_type.description: ADT object type code (e.g. CLAS/OC, PROG/P) of the object (single form).

object_type.description: ABAP object type for routed compact operation. Names the object's type in the single form.

parentName.description: Owning object, for a part of one: a function module's function group.

name: HandlerActivate
